source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-37

procedures.title: Camshaft (V8): install
steps: Hang the chain on the cam sprocket, holding the sprocket vertical with the chain below, lined up with the crank sprocket marks (see figure 19V in the manual).
Line up the camshaft dowel with the sprocket hole and fit the sprocket (see figure 24V in the manual).
Pull the sprocket onto the camshaft with its mounting bolts and torque to specifications.
Oil the chain with engine oil.
Install the fuel pump push rod (Section 6M).

procedures.title: Flywheel (V8): remove and install
steps: Remove the flywheel once the transmission and/or clutch housing and clutch are off the engine.
Installation: clean the flywheel and crankshaft mating faces so there are no burrs.
Fit the flywheel on the crankshaft with its dowel hole lined up with the crankshaft flange dowel (see figure 27V in the manual).
notes: With automatic transmission, the flywheel flange collar faces the transmission.

procedures.title: Engine mounts (V8): general
steps: Replace broken or deteriorated mounts right away, since they put extra strain on the other mounts and the driveline (see figure 28V in the manual).
notes: Mounts are non-adjustable and rarely need service.
